value.text: Susan Boyle: my relief at discovering that I have Asperger's

"In an exclusive interview with the Observer, [Boyle] has revealed that she was misdiagnosed [with brain damage] after complications at birth and has actually had Asperger's, a high-functioning form of autism."
"I have Asperger’s and it doesn’t define me, it gives a greater understanding of who I am."
